title: Intelligence Test: facts held at once
description: A short intelligence test in your browser. See all the facts at once, hide them, then answer a question from memory.
headline: How many facts can you hold at once?
sub: See a few short facts together, the full picture at once. Then they disappear and you answer one question about them. Each right answer adds a fact.
playNote: One person. It runs in your browser tab and keeps nothing. Laid out for a phone screen: one column, 44 px tap targets.

app.title: Ready when you are
app.text: You start with two facts. After each right answer the next round holds one more. Two wrong answers in a row at the same size end the run, and so does passing twelve.
app.hint: No timer. Every fact of the round is on screen together until you choose to hide them.
app.noscript: This test needs JavaScript. It runs entirely in your browser.

sections.title: How a round goes
paragraphs: Each round shows all of its facts together, in a shuffled order, with no timer. Take as long as you like to see the full picture. Press Hide the facts and ask when you are ready, and they are hidden for the rest of the round. You are then asked one question, such as which of the candidates is the fastest.
Pick a candidate, or pick Undetermined if the facts do not settle it. Then set how sure you are on a slider from 0 to 100 and lock in the answer.

sections.title: What a fact is
paragraphs: A fact carries meaning, not a number. A cat with three legs is impaired, and a train with no fuel is going nowhere. Each fact is about a different candidate and quietly rules that candidate out. Whoever is left is the answer.
Some rounds cannot be settled. When two candidates each do something only when the other does, nothing decides between them, and Undetermined is the right answer.

sections.title: Your rank
paragraphs: At the end you get a rank, set by the largest number of facts you answered correctly. Below it are a table of your accuracy at each size, a chart of your confidence beside your accuracy, a count of the undetermined rounds where you named a candidate anyway, and a short reading of your own numbers.
The rank is a name for the number of facts you held. It is not a comparison with other people, because we hold no data on anyone else.

sections.title: What stays on your device
paragraphs: The whole test is one script in the page. It makes no network request while you take it and stores nothing, so closing the tab clears your run.

closing.title: Ready when you are
closing.text: Press the button and see the first two facts.
